title: Beckenham
intro: A Kent-edge town with two big parks, a swimming lake in a Georgian estate and the Victorian dinosaurs of Crystal Palace a short ride away.

items.name: Kelsey Park
items.blurb: A peaceful park close to the High Street, with a long lake, herons and waterfowl, woodland walks and a café.
items.tip: The lakeside path makes a good short loop.

items.name: Beckenham Place Park
items.blurb: A huge park with ancient woodland, meadows and a Georgian mansion, and a restored lake where you can swim in summer.
items.tip: Book a swim in the lake on warm days; sessions sell out.

items.name: Crystal Palace dinosaurs
items.blurb: Life-size Victorian sculptures of dinosaurs and other extinct animals, made in the 1850s and Grade I listed, around the lakes of Crystal Palace Park.
items.tip: Children love them: walk the lake path to see them all.

items.name: South Norwood Lake
items.blurb: A Victorian reservoir lake ringed by trees, with sailing and fishing, between South Norwood and Crystal Palace.
items.tip: Combine it with the country park next door.
